record.label: Discretized Hamiltonian for 47 nuclei and 187 electrons
record.statement: The benchmark treats 47 nuclei and 187 electrons quantum mechanically on 5,616 system qubits. Appendix H.1 specifies the nuclear masses and the Coulomb saturation distances.
record.boundary: The circuit error is measured relative to evolution under this discretized Hamiltonian. Errors from the physical model and the grid discretization fall outside that bound.
